oneLine: Electromech Infraprojects files IPO papers to raise Rs 326 crore via fresh issue.
seller: Maniar family (promoters) and investor AIG Direct LLC

sources.title: AIG-backed Electromech Infraprojects files IPO papers, plans to raise Rs 326 crore via fresh issue

synopsis: AIG-backed Electromech Infraprojects has filed its draft red herring prospectus with SEBI to raise Rs 326 crore through a fresh issue of shares in its upcoming IPO. The public issue also includes an offer-for-sale of 18.91 lakh equity shares by the Maniar family and investor AIG Direct LLC. AIG Direct LLC holds a 7.04 percent stake in the company and proposes to offload 5.25 lakh equity shares through the OFS, while Shreyas Shibulal holds a 1.47 percent stake. The mechanical, electrical, and plumbing solutions provider intends to use Rs 100 crore of the fresh issue proceeds for working capital requirements and make investments in its subsidiaries. Arihant Capital Markets is the sole merchant banker managing the IPO.
